units.source_text: 其次比赛的是左方的《伊势物语》画卷

en.t: Next to be compared was the scroll of The Tale of Ise on the left side

units.source_text: 和右方的《正三位物语》画卷。

en.t: and the scroll of The Tale of the Senior Third Rank on the right side.

units.source_text: 两者优劣，亦甚难于判定。

en.t: It was also very difficult to judge which of the two was superior.

units.source_text: 但一般以为《正三位物语》画卷华丽多趣，

en.t: But people generally thought that the scroll of The Tale of the Senior Third Rank was splendid and full of interest,

units.source_text: 自宫中情景以至近世种种风习，都画得美妙动人。

en.t: from scenes within the palace to various customs of recent times, everything was painted with beauty and moving charm.
The Taira Chamberlain on the left side defended it, saying:
